topics.name: help
topics.title: Help Display
topics.description: Command to display help on console according to user requests.

content.heading: How to use help options
text: type <fg=yellow>cl help</> (without more) to list available topics.
type <fg=yellow>cl help [topic] [subtopic]</> to see the help.
Not all topics have subtopics - for these cases, subtopic will be simply ignored causing no error.
